title: The Wager with Wei Tong
summary: After the banquet the Lei and Xie families collapse, but the Blood Cloth Sect comes for revenge for Gu Ying. Its master Wei Tong, at Yuan Dan advanced, demands Gu Ying's killer, Ironwood Manor and the Lin family's submission. Lin Dong steps forward, flies out of reach with mental strength and threatens to vanish and train in secret if the sect attacks. He offers a wager instead, and Wei Tong agrees to a fight to the death at the Yan City arena in two months, with Blood Cloth Sect spies watching the family. Lin Dong sets out alone for Yan City with a hundred Yang Yuan Pills from his grandfather, leaving Wu Yun to watch over Qing Tan and Little Flame. He also needs a way to restore the Stone Talisman, whose power has faded, and he gets new clothes to enter the Thousand Gold Auction.
events: The Stone Talisman's power fails just as the Blood Cloth Sect reaches the Lin home.
Lin Zhentian sends Lin Ken and Lin Mang off with the juniors and faces Wei Tong.
Wei Tong demands Gu Ying's killer, Ironwood Manor and the Lin family's surrender.
Lin Dong admits killing Gu Ying and flies above the sect's archers with mental strength.
Lin Dong proposes a duel; Wei Tong sets it for two months later at the Yan City arena.
Lin Zhentian gives Lin Dong a hundred Yang Yuan Pills; Wu Yun promises to guard Qing Tan.
In Yan City Lin Dong buys new clothes to attend the Thousand Gold Auction.
cultivation: Wei Tong is at Yuan Dan advanced, said to match a 3rd Seal Symbol Master. Lin Zhentian is at Yuan Dan initial. Lin Dong is a 1st Seal Symbol Master and aims to reach the 2nd Seal in two months.
